content: MK reports that Niʿmat Allāh and Ṣāʾin al-Dīn were both objects of later 9th/15th-century Naqshbandi distaste, 'though for different reasons', shown in Jāmī's deliberate omission of both (and of Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī) from his Nafaḥāt al-Uns.
refers_to_primary: Jāmī, Nafaḥāt al-Uns (omission), via Binbaş and Algar
